title: 第15章 激战韩枫咱们这女婿不一般那第16章 三招已过韩枫你败了
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
韩家主殿。
得到消息的韩家家主韩正德脸色铁青的在房间内，来回踱着步。
“你能不能消停点？走来走去的，扰的人心烦意乱。”
穆三娘凤目一瞪，有些生气道。
“三娘，你说这个楚天铭不是胡闹，他怎么敢接受韩枫的挑战，他难道不知韩枫的本事？”
韩正德立马坐回了椅子上，气呼呼的说道。
“哼，那有什么，难道别人逼到头上，还要认怂不成？我看天铭做的没错。”
穆三娘倒是一脸淡定的说道。
“这不是认怂不认怂的问题，而是他拿什么跟韩枫打？拿命么？要知道韩枫下手一向狠辣，而且睚眦必报，是个心地狭窄之徒，我担心天铭会有生命安危！”
韩正德沉声道。
穆三娘却不以为然：“不是有我们么？我们到时候去观战，一旦韩枫真的出手要伤害天铭的话，我们便及时阻止便是。”
韩正德轻叹一声：“我就怕到时候，你我都没有机会出手。”
穆三娘安慰道：“放心，天铭那孩子，不是一个无脑莽夫，他既然敢接受应战，肯定有一定的把握，不会那么不堪一击的，我们要对他有信心才是。”
韩正德略带苦涩的笑了笑：“希望如此吧！”
……
三天后。
清晨时分。
韩清雪的闺房内。
楚天铭将银针缓缓收起，然后看着木桶当中的韩清雪道：“清雪，差不多可以了，你抬起头吧。”
韩清雪缓缓抬头，只见她脸上的红斑，已然尽退，一张完美无瑕的精致面容，出现在了他的视线当中。

只见她的眼睛如星星般闪烁，鼻梁高挺优雅，鼻尖娇小可爱，尽显独特魅力。
嘴唇如樱花花瓣，柔软而富有弹性。
吹弹可破的肌肤，白里透红。
这哪里还是一个丑八怪。
分明就是从画里走出来的绝世仙女。
旁边的楚天铭，看的心跳不已，没想到韩清雪的真实容貌，竟然如此美丽。
“你这么看我做什么。”
看着楚天铭直勾勾的望着自己，韩清雪脸上不禁浮现出娇羞的红霞，抿嘴笑道。
“咳咳，清雪，你真好看。”
楚天铭回过神来，挠了挠头，笑着说道。
“那还不是你的功劳。”
韩清雪感激道。
“咳咳，这都是我应该做的罢了。”
content_en:
The main hall of the Han family.
After receiving the news, the head of the Han family, Han Zhengde, looked livid and paced back and forth in the room.
"Can you please calm down? You are walking around and disturbing people."
Mu Sanniangfeng stared and said a little angry.
"Sanniang, you said this Chu Tianming is not fooling around. How dare he accept Han Feng's challenge? Doesn't he know Han Feng's ability?"
Han Zhengde immediately sat back on the chair and said angrily.
"Hmph, what's the matter? Are you going to give in when others push you? I think Tian Ming did the right thing."
Mu Sanniang said calmly.
"This is not a matter of giving in or not, but what is he going to do with Han Feng? Is it life-threatening? You know, Han Feng is always ruthless and will retaliate. He is a narrow-minded person. I am worried that Tian Ming's life will be in danger!"
Han Zhengde said in a deep voice.
Mu Sanniang disagreed: "Aren't we there? We will watch the battle then. If Han Feng really wants to hurt Tian Ming, we will stop him in time."
Han Zhengde sighed softly: "I'm afraid that by then, neither you nor I will have a chance to take action."
Mu Sanniang consoled him: "Don't worry, that kid Tianming is not a fool. Since he dares to accept the challenge, he must be certain that he won't be so vulnerable. We must have confidence in him."
Han Zhengde smiled slightly bitterly: "I hope so!"
…
Three days later.
Early morning hours.
In Han Qingxue's boudoir.
Chu Tianming slowly put away the silver needle, then looked at Han Qingxue in the barrel and said, "Qingxue, it's almost done. Just raise your head."
Han Qingxue slowly raised his head and saw that the red spots on her face had receded, and a flawless and delicate face appeared in his sight.
Her eyes twinkled like stars, her nose was high and elegant, and her nose was petite and cute, showing her unique charm.
Lips are like cherry blossom petals, soft and elastic.
The skin that can be broken by blowing is white and rosy.
This is still an ugly thing.
She is clearly the peerless fairy who walked out of the painting.
Next to him, Chu Tianming's heart beat wildly as he watched. He didn't expect Han Qingxue's true appearance to be so beautiful.
"Why do you look at me like that?"
Seeing Chu Tianming looking straight at her, Han Qingxue couldn't help but have a shy blush on her face, pursed her lips and smiled.
"Ahem, Qingxue, you are so beautiful."
Chu Tianming came back to his senses, scratched his head and said with a smile.
"That's not your fault."
Han Qingxue said gratefully.
"Ahem, this is what I should do."
